language.name: English
email.verify.subject: Confirm your email on Termoak
email.verify.intro: Hi %{name}. Confirm that this address is yours to finish activating your account.
email.verify.note: The link expires in 48 hours. If you did not create an account, ignore this email.
email.verify_code.subject: Your Termoak code: %{code}
email.verify_code.intro: Hi %{name}. Enter this code in Termoak to confirm your email and finish creating your account:
email.verify_code.expires: The code expires in %{minutes} minutes. Never share it with anyone.
email.verify_code.or_link: You can also confirm your email with this link:
email.verify_code.note: The link expires in 48 hours. If you did not create an account, ignore this email.
email.change.subject: Confirm your new email on Termoak
email.change.intro: Hi %{name}. Confirm this address to use it in your Termoak account.
email.change.note: The link expires in 48 hours. If you did not ask for the change, ignore this email.
email.reset.subject: Reset your Termoak password
email.reset.intro: Hi %{name}. Someone (hopefully you) asked to set a new password on your account.
email.reset.note: The link expires in 1 hour and signs you out on all your devices. If you did not ask for it, ignore this email: your password does not change.
email.invite.subject: You have been invited to Termoak
email.invite.intro: %{inviter} invites you to create an account on Termoak, an SSH client with persistent sessions, teams and AI.
email.invite.intro_team: %{inviter} invites you to join the team “%{team}” on Termoak, an SSH client with persistent sessions, teams and AI.
email.invite.note: The invitation is personal and expires in 7 days.
email.team_added.subject: You are now part of “%{team}”
email.team_added.intro: %{inviter} added you to the team “%{team}” on Termoak. You will see the sessions shared with the team.
email.team_added.note: You can leave the team whenever you want from your account.
push.team_added.title: New team
push.team_added.generic: You have been added to a team.
push.ai_approval.title: Approval pending
push.ai_approval.generic: An AI task wants to make a change and is waiting for your approval.
push.ai_finished.generic: Open the app to see the result.
push.session_shared.title: Session shared with you
push.session_shared.generic: Someone shared a session with you.
push.session_prompt.title: Your session needs an answer
push.session_prompt.generic: A server session is waiting for an answer (fingerprint or code).
push.join_request.title: Someone wants to join
push.join_request.generic: Someone is waiting to join a session you share.
push.control_request.title: Keyboard requested
push.control_request.generic: Someone asks for the keyboard of a session you share.
